prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live web access to look up current businesses, so I can’t point to one definitive “best” salon in Tyler right now. If you tell me whether you want spray tan, UV beds, or both and your neighborhood or ZIP code, I can give tailored suggestions.

Meanwhile, here’s a quick, practical way to find the best tanning salon in Tyler and what to look for:

How to search
- Use Google Maps, Yelp, or Facebook and search “spray tan near me,” “tanning salon,” or “UV tanning beds” plus “Tyler, TX.”
- Sort by rating and filter for recent reviews (last 6–12 months).

What to prioritize when choosing
- Type of tanning: spray tans (airbrush or booth), high-pressure/low-UV beds, stand-up units — choose based on your skin type and goals.
- Cleanliness: fresh towels, no lingering smell, sanitized booths between customers.
- Equipment: newer beds, high-pressure units for faster, less damaging color, or professional spray systems (e.g., VersaSpa, Norvell).
- Staff skill: certified spray technicians for custom shade and blending.
- Safety practices: eye protection provided, clear skin-typing guidance, written aftercare instructions.
- Reviews: look for consistent praise about results, customer service, and cleanliness; beware of repeated complaints about burns, hygiene, or pushy sales.
- Pricing & membership: check single sessions, packages, and tanning memberships — compare value.
- Hours & convenience: walk-in availability vs. appointment-only.

Red flags
- Poor, inconsistent reviews about cleanliness or staff rudeness.
- No sanitation between customers.
- Aggressive upselling or lacking basic safety info about UV exposure.

Questions to ask a salon (phone or walk-in)
- What types/brands of spray tan and beds do you have?
- How long have your technicians been doing spray tans? Are they certified?
- What is your sanitation protocol between customers?
- Do you offer patch tests for spray tans or consultations for bed tanning?
- Any current specials, packages, or membership plans?
- Can I see before/after photos or recent client reviews?

If you want, tell me:
- Spray vs. UV preference
- Your ZIP or part of Tyler
I’ll recommend the likely best options and help you evaluate any salons you find (you can paste names or review text).
